collection.label: Roman witnesses to Christ and the Christians
collection.author_name: Tacitus and Suetonius (early 2nd c. AD; 11th-century manuscripts)
collection.translator_name: Church and Brodribb (1869); J. C. Rolfe (1914)
collection.search_terms: tacitus annals 15.44 suetonius claudius nero chrestus christiani christians pilate nero fire roman witnesses
collection.description: What Roman historians of the early 2nd century wrote about Christ and the first Christians: Tacitus on Nero's punishment of the Christians and the execution of Christus under Pontius Pilate (Annals 15.44), and Suetonius on Claudius expelling the Jews over 'Chrestus' (Claudius 25.4) and on Nero's punishment of the Christians (Nero 16.2), each shown on the 11th-century manuscript page that carries it.

texts.title: Tacitus, Annals 15.44: Nero, the fire of Rome and the Christians
texts.source: Florence, Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana, Plut. 68.2, fol. 38r-38v (Teca Digitale IIIF) + Fisher's Latin and Church and Brodribb's English (Perseus)
texts.description: Tacitus' account of Nero blaming the Christians for the fire of Rome in 64 AD, with the earliest Roman mention of Christ's execution under Pontius Pilate, shown on the 11th-century manuscript that alone preserves this part of the Annals.

texts.title: Suetonius, Claudius 25.4: the Jews expelled from Rome 'at the instigation of Chrestus'
texts.date_approx: c. 121 AD (composition); 11th c. (Cod. Guelf. 268 Gud. lat.)
texts.source: Wolfenbuettel, HAB, Cod. Guelf. 268 Gud. lat., fol. 109v-110r (Wolfenbuetteler Digitale Bibliothek) + Ihm's Latin (Perseus) + Rolfe's English (LacusCurtius)
texts.description: Suetonius' one-sentence notice that Claudius expelled the Jews from Rome because they were rioting 'at the instigation of Chrestus', shown on an 11th-century manuscript page.

texts.title: Suetonius, Nero 16.2: 'punishment was inflicted on the Christians'
texts.date_approx: c. 121 AD (composition); 11th c. (Cod. Guelf. 268 Gud. lat.)
texts.source: Wolfenbuettel, HAB, Cod. Guelf. 268 Gud. lat., fol. 121r (Wolfenbuetteler Digitale Bibliothek) + Ihm's Latin (Perseus) + Rolfe's English (LacusCurtius)
texts.description: Suetonius lists the punishment of the Christians, 'a class of men given to a new and mischievous superstition', among Nero's measures, shown on an 11th-century manuscript page.
